title: Supply Installation Commissioning and Testing of CCTV System at Rajapur, Nanwel, Kanhoji Angre, Uttan, Satpati, Kanai kreek, Wasi Borsi and Luhara Lighthouses under Mumbai Directorate.
summary: Supply, installation, commissioning and testing of CCTV systems at eight lighthouses of the Mumbai Directorate: Rajapur, Nanwel, Kanhoji Angre, Uttan, Satpati, Kanai Creek, Wasi Borsi and Luhara.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

scope.item: Supply Installation Commissioning and Testing of CCTV System
scope.site: Rajapur, Nanwel, Kanhoji Angre, Uttan, Satpati, Kanai kreek, Wasi Borsi and Luhara Lighthouses (locations as per Annexure-VI)

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; original EMD to be submitted physically; MSME/NSIC registered bidders must also pay EMD. Hindi NIT prints estimated cost Rs 65,97,000 and EMD Rs 1,31,940 in the table (Rs 1,31,950 in its clause 1); English NIT prints Rs 65,97,256 and Rs 1,31,950.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Reputed contractors/firms of appropriate category registered with CPWD, State PWD, MES, Railways, BSNL etc. or other Central/State Government/Public sector organizations
Eligibility as per clause 3.1 of tender document (not included in this file)
notes: NIT dated 05/08/2026; Section I only (Hindi and English), no BOQ, Annexure-VI site list or specifications. Bid download/submission 05/08/2026 15:00 to 20/08/2026 15:00; original EMD by 20/08/2026 17:00; technical bid opening 21/08/2026 15:00.
